chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Al-Fudayl and Zurara and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Humran, that he asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Surely We revealed it on a blessed night.' He said: 'Yes, the Night of Pre-determination. And it is in every year in the month of Ramadan, in the last ten days. So the Quran was not revealed except during the Night of Pre-determination.'
Therein every wise affair is made distinct

He said: 'It is ordained during the Night of Pre-determination, everything that occurs in that year up to its like from the coming year, good and evil, obedience and disobedience, offspring, lifespan, or livelihood. So whatever is determined in that year and decreed, it is inevitable, and for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, therein is the Will.'
The Night of Predestination is better than a thousand months

I said, 'Which thing is meant by that?' So he said: 'The righteous deeds therein, from the Prayer, and the Zakat, and the varieties of goodness, are better than the deed during a thousand months wherein is not the Night of Pre-determination. And, had Allah, Blessed and High, not multiplied it for the believers, they would not have reached (success). But, Allah multiplies the good deeds for them through our love.'

key_terms.بِحُبِّنَا: Through our love (referring to the Imams/Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ: The Night of Pre-determination, a specific night in Ramadan

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Laylat al-Qadr and how are deeds multiplied on this night?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the theological concept of *Taqdir* (annual decree), where specific events such as lifespan and sustenance are determined for the coming year. It highlights the unique merit of Laylat al-Qadr by linking the multiplication of rewards not just to worship, but specifically to the love of the Ahl al-Bayt, a key tenet in Shia jurisprudence. The narration further clarifies that while decrees are made, they remain subject to Allah's will, balancing predestination with divine agency.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina, from Al Fuzayl, and Zurara, and Muhammad Bin Muslim,
(It has been narrated) from Humran who asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [44:3] Surely We Revealed it on a Blessed Night surely We are ever Warning. Heasws said: ‘Yes. The Night of Pre-determination. And it (occurs) during every year in a Month of Ramazan, during the last ten days. So the Quran was not Revealed except during the Night of Pre-determination’.
Heasws said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Says [44:4] Therein every wise affair is made distinct.

During the Night of Pre-determination, everything is Ordained, which is to transpire during that year up to its similar (night) from the coming year, be it good or evil, and obedience, and disobedience, and births, and terms (life-spans), or livelihoods. So, whatever is Determined during that year, and Ordained, so it is the inevitable, and for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic therein is the Desire’.
He (the narrator) said, ‘I said, [97:3] The Night of Predestination is better than a thousand months.

Which thing is Meant by that?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The righteous deeds therein, from the Prayer, and the Zakat, and the variety of the goodness, is better than the deed during a thousand months wherein is not Night of Pre-determination. And, had Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High not Multiplied it for the Believers, they would not have reached (success). But, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Multiplies the Rewards for them by our<sup>asws</sup> love’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Umar ibn ‘Udhaynah from al-Fudayl, Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim from Humran who has narrated the following: “I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about the following words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious: ‘We have revealed it during the blessed night.’ [44:3] He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, it is the night of destiny. Every year this night is during the last ten days in the month of Ramadan. It was the night of destiny and no other night when the Holy Quran was revealed.
Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, has said, “During this night all matters of wisdom are differentiated.’” [44:4]

He (Imam) said, ‘During the night of destiny, all things of good or evil, obedience or disobedience, birth or death, or sustenance that are to take place in the year up to the next month of Ramadan, are measured and determined. Whatever is measured and determined for that year becomes inevitable; however, Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, has a wish in it.’
He (the narrator) has said, ‘I then asked about the meaning of, “The night of destiny is better than one thousand nights?”’

He (Imam) replied, ‘Good deeds like salat (prayer), zakat and other forms of good are better than good deeds done in one thousand months wherein the night of destiny does not exist. Had it not been for the generosity of Allah, the most Blessed, the most High, toward the believing people, they could not gain any success, but Allah increases their good deeds (through our love).”’
